name: Wave
label: Wave — Wave public GraphQL
description: Official Wave public GraphQL. Docs: https://developer.waveapps.com/hc/en-us/articles/360019968212-API-Reference. One node; operations via `operation`. Single GraphQL endpoint. US/CA-centric. Supply official mutations in query; never PAN. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Wave. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: customer_create | invoice_create | invoice_list | transaction_list | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: Query
schema.description: GraphQL document. Required unless you rely on a stored default. customer_create uses customerCreate; invoice_create uses invoiceCreate. See https://developer.waveapps.com/hc/en-us/articles/360032569232-Mutation-Create-customer

schema.label: businessId
schema.description: Wave business id (GraphQL ID). Nested as variables.input.businessId on customer_create / invoice_create, or variables.businessId on list ops. Required by Wave mutations. https://developer.waveapps.com/hc/en-us/articles/360019968212-API-Reference

schema.label: name
schema.description: Customer name (business or person). Required on customer_create. Nested as variables.input.name. Example: Santa.

schema.label: firstName
schema.description: Customer first name. customer_create. Nested as variables.input.firstName. Example: Saint.

schema.label: lastName
schema.description: Customer last name. customer_create. Nested as variables.input.lastName. Example: Nicholas.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Customer email. customer_create. PII — do not log. Nested as variables.input.email.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO currency code. customer_create (customer default) or invoice_create. Example: CAD.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Customer phone. customer_create. Nested as variables.input.phone.

schema.label: mobile
schema.description: Customer mobile. customer_create. Nested as variables.input.mobile.

schema.label: website
schema.description: Customer website. customer_create. Nested as variables.input.website.

schema.label: customerId
schema.description: Wave customer id. Required on invoice_create. Nested as variables.input.customerId.

schema.label: items
schema.description: Invoice line items [{productId, quantity, price, description}]. invoice_create. Nested as variables.input.items. Example: [{"productId":"<PRODUCT_ID>"}].

schema.label: invoiceNumber
schema.description: Invoice number. invoice_create. Auto-assigned when omitted. Nested as variables.input.invoiceNumber.

schema.label: invoiceDate
schema.description: Invoice date YYYY-MM-DD. invoice_create. Nested as variables.input.invoiceDate.

schema.label: dueDate
schema.description: Invoice due date YYYY-MM-DD. invoice_create. Nested as variables.input.dueDate.

schema.label: memo
schema.description: Invoice memo. invoice_create. Nested as variables.input.memo.

schema.label: page
schema.description: List page (1-based) for invoice_list / transaction_list. Nested as variables.page.

schema.label: pageSize
schema.description: List page size for invoice_list / transaction_list. Nested as variables.pageSize. Example: 20.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: Http Status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: customer_create | invoice_create | invoice_list | transaction_list | trigger. Default customer_create. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Wave credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
